per-WP measured state with hashed evidence refs

discardable_layer.what: 19 MB partition table; rebuildable from the 31 sources by tools/u0_partition.py
2.6 MB subclaim candidates; rebuildable by tools/u1_subclaims.py
invariant gate; itself a tool, not evidence
the non-vacuity proof: the gate's verdict on a deliberately violated tree

misplacements.what: the r6 control document exists both in the previous round directory and in the Fabric mirror (INTEGRATION/FHS/docs/as-built/W0/)
misplacements.why_it_matters: two copies of one document invite a reader to quote whichever is handier
misplacements.detail: the Fabric copy is declared NON_AUTHORITATIVE in INTEGRATION/FHS/docs/as-built/README.md; the round copy is the working parent of r7. r7 is published to the same mirror with the same declaration, so the pair stays distinguishable by layer, not by filename

misplacements.what: 19 MB and 2.6 MB raw tables sit inside the round directory
misplacements.why_it_matters: a naive publish would put a 19 MB derived table into a repository
misplacements.detail: they live under evidence/*/raw/, the gate refuses oversize outside raw/, and the publish step excludes raw/ by name

misplacements.what: the WP-16 report was mutated four times during the non-vacuity test
misplacements.why_it_matters: a mutated evidence file that was not restored would silently disagree with its own report
misplacements.detail: each mutation was made from a byte backup and restored with cp -p; the restored sha256 equals the pre-injection value recorded in the test transcript (ae17b9fa…, cf21cd62…, a823b6bc…) and the gate returned to 15/15 PASS

misplacements.what: the round wrote nothing into any repository until the publish step
misplacements.why_it_matters: G8 must be able to say 'the repos are unchanged' as a comparison, not a claim
misplacements.detail: G8 compares HEAD and dirty-path count against the WP-00 baseline for all three worktrees: 0 drift
